proof_roadmap: Exclude Delta(h,k) by the author diameter argument

Cover small h-fold cardinalities by filling sets
Compute sparse/dense generating functions and parameter decrement scales
Show each parameter family gives an interval, overlap adjacent b families, and match endpoints
Combine the current two range propositions to prove Theorem1.4
